villain.qamar.2: The suspect was wearing white silk gloves -- the kind a conservator would use
villain.qamar.3: The suspect asked the curator about provenance records before the theft
villain.saffron.name: Saffron Suleiman
villain.saffron.0: The suspect smelled strongly of saffron and cardamom
villain.saffron.1: He was carrying a small brass merchant's scale
villain.saffron.2: The suspect's fingers were stained yellow -- turmeric, perhaps
villain.saffron.3: A spice pouch was found near the broken lock
villain.layla.name: Layla Lapis
villain.layla.0: The suspect wore a striking lapis lazuli pendant
villain.layla.1: The suspect was only spotted after dark
villain.layla.2: The suspect's nails were painted a deep midnight blue
villain.layla.3: A turquoise bead was found at the scene
villain.tariq.name: Tariq al-Tariq
villain.tariq.0: The break-in happened just before the dawn prayer
villain.tariq.1: He carried a set of antique brass keys on his belt
villain.tariq.2: The suspect entered through a window no one thought could open
villain.tariq.3: A night guard said the suspect moved like someone who already knew the layout
villain.minara.name: Minara Mirage
villain.minara.0: Plaster dust was found under the suspect's fingernails
villain.minara.1: The suspect was photographing the tilework on the mihrab
villain.minara.2: The suspect carried a small chisel in a velvet pouch
villain.minara.3: A carved stone screen panel was surgically removed from the wall
villain.fakhr.name: Fakhr the Forger
villain.fakhr.0: The suspect's hands were stained with walnut ink
villain.fakhr.1: The suspect was seen practicing Arabic calligraphy in a cafe
villain.fakhr.2: He carried a reed qalam pen behind his ear
villain.fakhr.3: A magnifying loupe was found near the empty manuscript case
villain.dinar.name: Dinar Dervish
villain.dinar.0: The guard said the suspect was spinning slowly, almost hypnotically
villain.dinar.1: Gold coin wrappers were found in the stairwell
villain.dinar.2: He was humming a Sufi devotional melody
villain.dinar.3: The vault was emptied while every guard watched the courtyard performance
villain.henna.name: Henna Hazara
villain.henna.0: A tiny henna dot was found on the doorframe
villain.henna.1: Security footage shows the suspect in three different outfits in one hour
villain.henna.2: The suspect changed appearance between the market and the mosque
villain.henna.3: A wig and colored contact lenses were discarded in the alley
villain.kohl.name: Kohl Phantom
villain.kohl.0: No one actually saw the suspect -- only her shadow
villain.kohl.1: A miniature surveillance camera was found taped under a bench
villain.kohl.2: The suspect's eyes were lined with thick kohl
villain.kohl.3: The suspect seemed to know exactly where the blind spots in the cameras were
villain.murad.name: Murad al-Mutayyah
villain.murad.0: He vanished into the medina and no one could follow
villain.murad.1: The suspect wore leather sandals worn thin from running
villain.murad.2: A crumpled map of the old city's back alleys was found in a drain
villain.murad.3: The police chase ended at a dead-end wall -- but the suspect was gone
villain.soraya.name: Soraya Samum
villain.soraya.0: A smoke device was triggered just before the theft
villain.soraya.1: Witnesses described a sudden cloud of dust in the gallery
villain.soraya.2: The suspect wore a desert scarf wrapped loosely around her face
villain.soraya.3: The fire alarm went off on the opposite side of the building -- a diversion
villain.nasreen.name: Nasreen Nightshade
villain.nasreen.0: The guard fell asleep at his post -- a faint floral scent lingered
villain.nasreen.1: A rose petal was found on the empty pedestal
villain.nasreen.2: The suspect was carrying a small glass vial in her handbag
villain.nasreen.3: The suspect asked about local medicinal herbs at the souq
villain.jalal.name: Jalal al-Jinn
villain.jalal.0: The museum director said a charming visitor offered to double the endowment
villain.jalal.1: The suspect made promises that sounded too good to be true
villain.jalal.2: The suspect was wearing an expensive suit and a signet ring
villain.jalal.3: A forged donation receipt was left on the administrator's desk
villain.zubayr.name: Zubayr Zero

villain.zubayr.1: He was seen sketching geometric star patterns on a napkin
villain.zubayr.2: The suspect left a sequence of numbers scratched into the glass
villain.zubayr.3: A USB device was found plugged into the back of the ticket kiosk
villain.ivory.name: Ivory Ismail
villain.ivory.0: The suspect was overheard negotiating a price in three languages
villain.ivory.1: He had callused hands -- the hands of someone who packs crates
villain.ivory.2: A shipping manifest for Zanzibar was found in the trash
villain.ivory.3: An antique ivory-handled knife was used to pry open the case
villain.rumi.name: Rumi the Riddle
villain.rumi.0: A riddle in Ottoman script was left pinned to the empty frame
villain.rumi.1: He was muttering couplets to himself as he left
villain.rumi.2: The suspect quoted Hafez to a bewildered security guard
villain.rumi.3: A handwritten verse was tucked inside the broken display
